RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not inherently prove discrimination. In modern broadcasting, digital media expertise is often prioritized over traditional newsroom tenure, making the successful candidate's specific background a legitimate editorial rationale. 

A two-week wait for written HR feedback is standard organizational delay, not an admission of wrongdoing. Raising allegations of sex bias without concrete evidence—such as documented procedural violations or discriminatory remarks—will appear reactionary, damage your professional reputation, and burn bridges at the broadcaster. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused strictly on your interview performance and the competencies required for future editorial roles.
